_scaffold_note: First general-sweep map, route mode. Player = generic HP-bar anchor (no character). Mobs = models/mob_generic.pt. attack_range/aoe_max/gather numbers are starting guesses.
_player_note: Empty {} = default red-HP-bar detection (DEFAULTS in player.py). Add hue_lo / sat_val_lo / foot_offset / bar-geometry overrides here only if the anchor misgrabs on this map.
_gather_note: z = push/gather (path-scoop) skill, 1s cooldown: dashes forward and scoops mobs along the path into a clump within attack_range, doubling as forward locomotion. grp/min/dash_gap are starting guesses: grp=how spread mobs must be to bother scooping, min=fewest mobs worth a scoop, dash_gap=attack_range - dash reach. Tune live.
_minimap_note: Minimap crop measured from a capture frame. The recording showed the same minimap x at the same place every lap (start ~43, portal ~214, jump ~195), so route until_x waypoints are stable despite the wide map.
_map_box_note: Valid minimap-dot box [x_min,x_max,y_min,y_max]. y_min 48 rejects the phantom reads seen in the recording (y 5-40 is not a platform level); levels are y~55 (upper), 62-84 (right platforms/slope), 99-109 (bottom).
_route_note: Recorded from a human run (routes/flat_sweep.capture.jsonl, cycle t 0.7-81.6s) via build_sweep_route.py. Start the character at bottom-left (minimap x~43) before farming.
_band_note: Only mobs whose feet are within this many screen px above/below her feet count (sweep decide is x-only). Levels here are ~600px apart, so 180 separates them. Without it she FIREd forever at upper-floor mobs in x-range. Override one side with band_up / band_down.
